items.title: Watch: Family escapes home during Colombia earthquake
items.dek: At least 132 people are dead and a state of emergency has been declared after Colombia was hit by one of its largest earthquakes in years.
items.body: At least 132 people are dead and a state of emergency has been declared after Colombia was hit by one of its largest earthquakes in years.

items.title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
items.dek: The US president was moved from the old Air Force One to a military plane as he left a Nato summit in Turkey last month, US media say.
items.body: The US president was moved from the old Air Force One to a military plane as he left a Nato summit in Turkey last month, US media say.

items.title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
items.dek: The ex-president is convicted of committing war crimes and crimes against humanity during the country's civil war.
